answers.reason: The student only takes part where their own faculty matters are decided and is not a member of the central senate.
The budget planning round is a central body where the student does not have their assigned place.
Appointment committees handle professorships, which are outside the student's assigned decision body.
The student is a member of the faculty and takes part where their faculty matters are decided.
Study commissions handle faculty teaching matters, which are part of the student's faculty affairs.
Examination boards decide on student examination matters within the faculty.
Internal research funding deals with research grants rather than student matters.
